name: FedEx Freight Hub - Stockton CA
type: Freight LTL hub service center (Northern California)

fieldNotes.location: Roster address '4444 S B St, Stockton CA 95206' and coordinates (37.908392, -121.244053, RANGE_INTERPOLATED) resolve to a modern big-box distribution-warehouse park in south Stockton - NOT an LTL freight hub. The FedEx Freight STK service center is consistently listed (FedEx Freight STK page, Waze, Yellow Pages, Indeed) at 4520 S Highway 99 / 4520 CA-99, Stockton, CA 95215. Geocoding places that address at ~37.9118, -121.2235, where satellite reveals an LTL cross-dock terminal complex along the SR-99 corridor (long narrow cross-dock buildings with trailers backed in on both faces, dock aprons, dense rows of pup trailers).
fieldNotes.facilityIdentity: The cross-dock terminal complex at the resolved location is unmistakably an LTL truck terminal. Street View (2026-03) shows SAIA branding at the main cross-dock's SW frontage, indicating the complex hosts SAIA LTL Freight; the FedEx Freight STK terminal (address 4520 S Hwy 99) is either co-located in this multi-carrier terminal complex or occupies an adjacent cross-dock within it. Facility type and corridor location are confident; the exact FedEx building footprint within the complex could not be confirmed with FedEx signage - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.truckGate: LTL cross-dock terminal yards in this complex are perimeter-fenced with controlled gates (a metal security fence and gate visible in Street View along S Highway 99 frontage road).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth identified; LTL service centers of this size typically use remote/kiosk gate check-in. Classified remoteGs true, low-medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long narrow cross-dock building(s) with a dense regular rhythm of dock doors on both long faces, trailers backed in; estimate ~90+ doors -> 50+ band. Overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive paved trailer parking with dense rows of pup trailers without tractors; firmly 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage yard flanks the cross-dock buildings.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved aprons and yard between the gate and docks give room for a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved terminal apron gives physical room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The S Highway 99 terminal corridor hosts multiple LTL cross-dock buildings/operations (SAIA confirmed; FedEx Freight STK address geocodes into the same complex).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Stockton metro industrial fabric along the SR-99 corridor; classified Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the terminal yard; classified false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the perimeter box around the terminal complex; FedEx Freight's portion is a subset.
